Thanks Alex — appreciate the context. Two quick notes before we lock a time:

1) Given the goals you listed (deployment options + latency/cost + integration), we recommend converting the 30-minute intro into a 90–120 minute technical deep-dive so we can:
   - Run through an integration path (SDK, auth, network flows)
   - Surface realistic perf numbers using a small synthetic prompt set
   - Walk through a sample rollout/rollback plan and security controls

2) Marissa (cc'd) will own the product demo; I want to loop in one of our engineering leads to answer architecture questions. Rishi (engineering) can join if we make this a deep-dive.

One constraint: Priya mentioned exec travel next week (I see a calendar blocker on Dec 7–10). If you need the 30m overview next week for execs, we can do it, but if you want the deep-dive with engineers present we'll need to move to the following week.

Proposed deep-dive windows (PT):
- Mon, Dec 13, 1:00–3:00 PM
- Tue, Dec 14, 10:00 AM–12:00 PM

If you prefer the short 30m version for leadership next week, I'm available Wed Dec 8 at 9:30 AM PT (30m).

Let me know which path you prefer and we'll adjust attendees/agenda. Attaching a suggested agenda for the deep-dive.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

We're leaning toward the technical deep-dive (the product team wants to see the integration patterns and our infra team needs to validate the network model). Priya will be traveling Dec 7–10 and has limited bandwidth next week, so Dec 13 or 14 works better.

Can we lock Mon, Dec 13, 1:00–3:00 PM PT? That slot looks clean for our core group (Priya will dial in remotely). A couple of asks so we can prep on our side:
- Can you share the SOW draft and any checklist for what you need access to in our staging environment?
- Our infra lead wants to see a brief diagram of the network flow + auth model ahead of time (I've attached a high-level diagram).
- Procurement: we need an initial ballpark for dedicated vs hosted per-req costs to assess budget before the deep-dive — a top-line estimate is fine.

I'll send a calendar invite after you confirm attendees from Redwood.

Appreciate it — looking forward.

Alex
